Bad experience - ripped off
May 2026 • Friends
Food was ok. Be warned - check your bill. We didn’t. We foolishly trusted the waiter who said he had lived and worked in Australia and wanted to return. It seems he was just engaging us . We tipped him. Paid by card and just checking our debits realized we were charged $AU 186.00 for a simple probably $20.00 at the most bill. That is paid 186 instead of 18.60. DO NOT GO THERE. This is the only negative experience we have had in 3 weeks. Do go to Pizza 4 Ps. Sustainable, organic and trustworthy
